Called Meeting of City Council
October 15, 1877
Council called to order at 8.15 P.M.
Mayor De Gress in the Chair
Roll called and the following members
answered
Aldermen Deffenbaugh, James, Taylor
and Wilkins
Absent Aldermen Bremond, Cook
Garmour, Maas, Robinson and Ward.
No quorum
On motion of Alderman James the
Council adjourned to 9 Oclock A.M. tomorrow

[signature]
City Clerk

Called Meeting of City Council
October 24th 1874
Council called to order at 8 oclock
P.M. Mayor DeGress in the Chair
Roll called and the following members
answered
Aldermen Cook, Deffenbaugh, James,
Maas, Robinson, Taylor and Wilkins
Absent Aldermen Bremond, Garmour
and Ward. Quorum present.
The Mayor informed the Council that he
had called them together for the purpose of presenting to them his annual report as
required by city Ordinances.
Mayors Report
Mayor's Office Austin Texas
October 20th 1874
To the
Hon Board of Aldermen
City of Austin
